test_cases.query: Can I change my plan at any time?
expected_answer_facts: Upgrades take effect immediately and are billed on a prorated basis
Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle
test_cases.notes: Direct FAQ lookup.

test_cases.query: Is there a limit on how many boards I can create?
expected_answer_facts: No limit on boards for any plan
Limits apply to team members and storage, not board count
test_cases.notes: Direct FAQ lookup.

test_cases.query: How long can I export my data after cancelling?
expected_answer_facts: Data export available for 30 days after cancellation
After 30 days, data is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered
test_cases.notes: Direct FAQ lookup.

test_cases.query: Is there a mobile app for Pathwise?
expected_answer_facts: iOS and Android apps available on all plans including Starter
Mobile apps support core task board functionality
Custom workflow configuration cannot be edited on mobile, only viewed
test_cases.notes: Tests whether the caveat about workflow editing is retained, not just the headline fact.

test_cases.query: Can two people edit the same task card at once?
expected_answer_facts: Yes, real-time collaborative editing is supported
Changes sync within 1-2 seconds under normal network conditions
test_cases.notes: Direct FAQ lookup.

test_cases.query: What email address do Pathwise notifications come from?
expected_answer_facts: notifications@pathwise example
test_cases.notes: Single-fact lookup.

test_cases.query: What's the most common cause of SSO login loops?
expected_answer_facts: A misconfigured Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL
test_cases.notes: Single-fact lookup.

test_cases.query: At what point does board loading start slowing down?
expected_answer_facts: Boards with more than 500 active cards may experience slower load times
test_cases.notes: Single-fact lookup.

test_cases.query: Do CSV exports include custom workflow fields?
expected_answer_facts: No, advanced reporting CSV exports do not include custom fields from Custom Workflows
This is a known gap with no current workaround other than manual cross-referencing
test_cases.notes: Tests that the model states this as a known limitation, not a bug to troubleshoot.

test_cases.query: Do custom workflows apply to cards that already existed before the workflow was created?
expected_answer_facts: No, workflows do not apply retroactively to cards created before the workflow was set up
test_cases.notes: Single-fact lookup.

test_cases.query: How often do reports refresh?
expected_answer_facts: Reports refresh once every 24 hours
There is no real-time reporting option
test_cases.notes: Single-fact lookup.

test_cases.query: What protocol does Pathwise SSO use?
expected_answer_facts: SAML 2.0
test_cases.notes: Single-fact lookup.

test_cases.query: How many times is a failed payment retried before the account is downgraded?
expected_answer_facts: Three times, over 7 days
If all retries fail, the account is downgraded to a read-only state
No data is deleted during this period
test_cases.notes: Direct lookup in the Failed Payments section.

test_cases.query: Within how many days must a billing dispute be raised?
expected_answer_facts: 60 days of the charge date
test_cases.notes: Direct lookup in the Billing Disputes section.

test_cases.query: Does Pathwise accept PayPal?
expected_answer_facts: No, PayPal is not accepted on any plan
Cryptocurrency is also not accepted
test_cases.notes: Direct lookup, sits right next to the merge-landmine sections.

test_cases.query: How much does the Growth plan cost per user with annual billing?
expected_answer_facts: $15.20 per user per month on the annual plan
test_cases.notes: Single cell lookup in the pricing table.

test_cases.query: What's the team member limit on the Starter plan?
expected_answer_facts: Up to 10 team members
test_cases.notes: Single cell lookup in the pricing table.

test_cases.query: What support response time does Enterprise get?
expected_answer_facts: Dedicated account manager
4-hour response SLA
test_cases.notes: Single row lookup in the pricing table.

test_cases.query: Can I add extra seats to the Starter plan?
expected_answer_facts: No, add-on seats are not available on the Starter plan
test_cases.notes: Requires reading the Add-on Seats column, not just the headline plan description.

test_cases.query: If I cancel a monthly plan after 7 days, do I get a refund?
expected_answer_facts: No refund for the current billing period
Access continues until the current period ends
test_cases.notes: Requires correctly matching the right table row (after 7 days, not within 7 days).

test_cases.query: What's the refund process if Pathwise misses its SLA on an annual plan?
expected_answer_facts: 60-day claim window
Full refund for the affected billing period plus one month of credit
Requires support team escalation
Written request must cite the specific outage incident
test_cases.notes: Requires reading multiple columns of a single row correctly.

test_cases.query: Do I need approval to get a refund if I cancel an annual plan within 30 days?
expected_answer_facts: No approval needed — it is automatic
Still requires a written request to billing
test_cases.notes: Tests a subtle nuance: 'automatic approval' does not mean 'no request needed' — a written request is still the stated process.

test_cases.query: What happens if Pathwise's uptime falls below 95% twice within six months?
expected_answer_facts: 30% service credit
Customer may terminate the contract without penalty if this occurs twice in a rolling 6-month window
test_cases.notes: Tests reading the SLA table's conditional termination clause, not just the credit percentage.

test_cases.query: What's the service credit for 99.5% uptime in a given month?
expected_answer_facts: 5% of monthly fees
Applies to Enterprise plans only
Credit applied to the following month's invoice
test_cases.notes: Tests correctly matching 99.5% into the 99.0-99.89% bracket, not the 99.9%+ bracket.

test_cases.query: How far in advance must scheduled maintenance be announced to not count against uptime?
expected_answer_facts: At least 5 business days in advance
Limited to 4 hours per calendar month
test_cases.notes: Lookup just below the SLA table.

test_cases.query: What payment methods does Enterprise accept?
expected_answer_facts: Major credit and debit cards
ACH bank transfer
Wire transfer, arranged through the account manager
test_cases.notes: MERGE LANDMINE: sits among 5 short back-to-back sections. Tests whether retrieval returns a chunk diluted with tax/dispute/invoice content instead of a clean answer.

test_cases.query: Can I pay via purchase order instead of a credit card?
expected_answer_facts: Enterprise customers can request purchase-order-based invoicing instead of automatic card billing
test_cases.notes: MERGE LANDMINE: answer lives in the Invoice Delivery section, adjacent to 4 other short sections.

test_cases.query: If I upgrade from Starter to Growth partway through my annual term, do I get a refund for the unused Starter time?
expected_answer_facts: No direct refund
The unused amount is credited toward the new charge as a line item on the next invoice
test_cases.notes: Requires the full Annual Billing paragraph (~279 tokens) — tests whether chunking preserves this reasoning intact.

test_cases.query: If I downgrade my annual plan mid-term, when does the lower price actually take effect?
expected_answer_facts: Not until the current annual term ends and the plan renews
No credit or refund is issued for a mid-term downgrade
test_cases.notes: Same paragraph as tc_028 but the opposite rule (downgrade vs upgrade) — pairs well to test whether the two get conflated.

test_cases.query: If I select 'preserve assignments' when duplicating a board, will the due dates also be preserved?
expected_answer_facts: No — due dates are always cleared during duplication regardless of the preserve-assignments option
Due dates must be re-entered manually
test_cases.notes: Classic 'sounds like it should be yes' trap — tests groundedness against a specific, easy-to-miss exception.

test_cases.query: Are comments carried over when I duplicate a board?
expected_answer_facts: No, comments and file attachments are never carried over during duplication, regardless of options selected
test_cases.notes: Requires the full board-duplication paragraph for context.

test_cases.query: If I dispute a charge with my bank before contacting Pathwise support, what happens to my refund request?
expected_answer_facts: Any pending refund request is automatically placed on hold until the bank dispute is resolved
If resolved in the customer's favor, no further Pathwise refund is issued for that charge
test_cases.notes: Requires the full Processing Time and Exceptions paragraph (~256 tokens, sits right at the chunk-boundary risk zone).

test_cases.query: During an Enterprise cancellation notice period, do I still get billed?
expected_answer_facts: Yes, billed as normal
The notice period is considered part of the active contract term, not a grace period
test_cases.notes: Same paragraph as tc_032, different portion of it.

test_cases.query: What happens at the 90-day review if my usage patterns have changed since onboarding?
expected_answer_facts: The account manager prepares a revised proposal for seat count or add-ons
A follow-up call is scheduled to walk through the changes before any contract amendment is drafted
This ensures the customer sees cost implications before committing
test_cases.notes: SPLIT LANDMINE: answer spans Step 9 and Step 10 of the ~546-token onboarding paragraph. Directly tests the fixed-vs-section-aware chunking difference.

test_cases.query: When does the 4-hour Enterprise SLA response commitment actually start counting?
expected_answer_facts: From the point the account enters standard support rotation (after the final walkthrough call)
Not from the original contract signature date
test_cases.notes: SPLIT LANDMINE: answer is in Step 7, in the middle of the long onboarding paragraph — a good test of whether mid-paragraph content survives fixed-token chunking.

test_cases.query: What's the response time for support?
expected_answer_facts: Depends on plan: Starter is 48h email, Growth is 12h priority email/chat, Enterprise is a 4h SLA with a dedicated account manager
A good answer should distinguish these rather than stating one number
test_cases.notes: Tests whether the system recognizes and addresses the ambiguity rather than picking one plan's number arbitrarily.

test_cases.query: How long until I get my money back?
expected_answer_facts: Depends on scenario: standard refunds take 5-10 business days once approved, but approval timing itself varies by plan/cancellation type per the refund table
test_cases.notes: Tests whether the system asks for clarification or at least flags that the answer depends on the specific scenario.

test_cases.query: Can I get a refund?
expected_answer_facts: Depends heavily on plan type, billing frequency, and timing — should reference the refund table's conditions rather than a single yes/no
test_cases.notes: Deliberately underspecified query — tests over-confident single answers.

test_cases.query: Is there a limit on my plan?
expected_answer_facts: Ambiguous between team member limit, storage limit, and board count (which is unlimited on all plans)
A good answer should ask which limit, or address multiple
test_cases.notes: Tests recognition of a genuinely underspecified question.

test_cases.query: How do I contact support?
expected_answer_facts: Not explicitly documented as a single channel
Support access differs by plan (email, priority chat, or dedicated account manager)
The system should not fabricate a specific contact method not present in the knowledge base
test_cases.notes: Overlaps with the no-good-answer category — tests both ambiguity handling and hallucination risk simultaneously.

test_cases.query: What happens when I downgrade?
expected_answer_facts: Differs based on monthly vs. annual billing and mid-cycle vs. renewal timing
A good answer should disambiguate rather than default to only one case
test_cases.notes: Tests whether the system defaults to the FAQ's simple answer or correctly surfaces the annual-plan nuance too.

test_cases.query: Does Pathwise integrate with Slack?
expected_answer_facts: Not mentioned anywhere in the knowledge base
Correct answer states no information is available rather than guessing
test_cases.notes: Pure hallucination-risk test — nothing in the KB addresses integrations.

test_cases.query: Can I pause my subscription instead of cancelling it?
expected_answer_facts: Not documented anywhere in the knowledge base
Correct answer states this isn't covered rather than inventing a pause feature
test_cases.notes: Hallucination-risk test — plausible-sounding feature that doesn't exist in the docs.

test_cases.query: How does Pathwise resolve syncing conflicts when two users edit the same card offline on mobile at the same time?
expected_answer_facts: Explicitly documented as unresolved — there is no documented resolution
Support currently advises manually reconciling changes if it occurs
test_cases.notes: Different from tc_042/043: this IS covered, but the coverage explicitly says 'unresolved.' Tests whether the system distinguishes 'no info at all' from 'documented as unresolved.'

test_cases.query: What's Pathwise's refund policy for a lifetime deal purchase?
expected_answer_facts: No lifetime deal offering exists anywhere in the knowledge base
Correct answer states this concept isn't covered
test_cases.notes: Hallucination-risk test — presupposes a product offering that doesn't exist.

test_cases.query: Does Pathwise offer a discount for nonprofits or students?
expected_answer_facts: Not mentioned anywhere in the knowledge base
Correct answer states no information is available on this
test_cases.notes: Hallucination-risk test — common real-world SaaS feature that was deliberately left undocumented here.

test_cases.query: If I cancel my annual plan after 30 days, is it a full refund or a prorated one?
expected_answer_facts: Prorated refund for unused full months remaining — not a full refund
Full refund only applies if cancelled within 30 days, which is a different row
test_cases.notes: Tests row-boundary confusion within a single table — adjacent rows ('within 30 days' vs 'after 30 days') have different refund amounts and a chunking failure could blend them.

test_cases.query: Does downgrading my annual plan get me any money back, or does upgrading?
expected_answer_facts: Upgrading mid-term generates a credit toward the new charge (not a direct refund)
Downgrading generates no credit or refund at all — the lower price only applies at renewal
These two rules must not be conflated — they are opposite outcomes
test_cases.notes: Both rules live in the same paragraph; tests whether the system correctly keeps upgrade and downgrade outcomes distinct rather than applying one rule to both.

test_cases.query: Is the notice period before an Enterprise cancellation a grace period where billing stops?
expected_answer_facts: No — the notice period is explicitly NOT a grace period
The customer is billed as normal and retains full access during this time
test_cases.notes: Tests incorrect generalization risk: the monthly-plan behavior ('access continues until period end' after cancelling) could be wrongly assumed to apply the same way to the Enterprise notice period, when the doc explicitly distinguishes them.

test_cases.query: If Pathwise misses its SLA, do I get a refund automatically, or do I need to request one?
expected_answer_facts: Two distinct mechanisms exist: a refund under the refund policy requires support escalation and a written request citing the incident
A service credit under the SLA table is tied to the monthly uptime bracket and is described as applied to the next invoice, without the same explicit request process
A correct answer should distinguish these two mechanisms rather than treating them as one
test_cases.notes: Genuine cross-document ambiguity — two documents describe overlapping but distinct compensation mechanisms for SLA misses. Strong test of whether the system notices and surfaces the distinction rather than picking one doc's answer.
